data.body: Story D (1ecf) done and pushed as Gerrit change 1017 (stacked on 1016). Docs-only leaf, no held-out TDD (nothing behavioural); verified its central claim myself first by re-running find_referencing_symbols on _anthropic_cache_settings: Serena returned the import + all five real call sites but NOT tests/interfaces/store/test_execution_mode_dispatch.py:90 (monkeypatch.setattr string literal) - the ticket's evidence reproduces exactly. NEW finding beyond the ticket: every line number Serena reported was consistently ONE LESS than the working tree's 1-based numbers (27 vs 28, 336 vs 337, 312/316/317 vs 313/317/318), i.e. 0-based - so the line-number row of the new table is justified by an offset as well as by index lag. AGENTS.md section grew +13/-7 = net 6 lines (AC caps growth at 'a few'); evidence moved to new docs/code-navigation.md, indexed in docs/README.md. Pre-flight: make lint clean; 41 docs-guard tests pass (incl. test_check_docs_index, which requires every docs/*.md be indexed). Commit gate initially REJECTED the message: subject was 52 chars vs the repo's 50/72 rule - shortened, then passed. Story A (4143) is blocked by C+D until they close, so claiming B (84c7) next.
